description: Garibaldi Provincial Park is a wonder in British Columbia, Canada, with 10 glaciers, over 100 km of hiking trails, and a rich history. The park is named after Giuseppe Garibaldi and is a popular destination for outdoor enthusiasts. Follow us for more outdoor adventures.
